description.en: Sound design system and acoustic tactile feedback for shadcn/ui components.
description.zh: 专为 shadcn/ui 组件量身定做的声音设计系统与声学触觉反馈工具包。

content.en: sensory-ui bridges sound design and frontend architecture by providing a unified acoustic design system for shadcn/ui. Featuring expertly engineered Web Audio synth patches, mechanical clicks, and spatial chimes, it transforms ordinary web interactions into multi-sensory experiences.
content.zh: sensory-ui 将专业声音设计系统与现代前端组件工程融为一体。专为 shadcn/ui 打造，它内置了通过 Web Audio API 合成的物理拟真按键微音、精密齿轮滚动手感音与空间立体感提示音，以零外部音频文件的纯合成方式，实现多维感官沉浸。
